text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock B and Stock C at a profit felt satisfying, but I should sell only when it fits my investment plan—not just to lock in a gain.","I should not let my average cost or reluctance to admit a mistake dictate what I do; judge each holding by its prospects from today.","Small monthly swings do not require action. I trade infrequently, so I should stay patient and make deliberate decisions rather than react to short-term moves."]}
